feeNotes: Year 1 is MSRIT's official 2026-27 total for Karnataka students; students from outside Karnataka pay more (Rs 1,800 more for B.E. and B.Arch).
Hostel, mess and transport are not included: MSRIT doesn't publish those fees online. Ask the hostel office.
scholarshipNotes: Scholarships at MSRIT are mainly Government of Karnataka and Government of India schemes; the amounts are set by those schemes.
Applications are handled by the Admission and Scholarship Section, around September each year.
